violations.text: Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the 1-door low boy milk cooler. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the coffee area dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The dump sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
